name: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Limited

facts.business: KRN Heat Exchanger and Refrigeration Limited manufactures heat exchangers and condensers, evolving into a global thermal engineering platform for HVAC&R industry.
key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to significant growth and new trading activity
Carrying value of investments in and loans to subsidiary companies
Foreign currency risk primarily with respect to US Dollar
Credit risk from trade receivables and financial assets
facts.related_party_note: Revenue transactions with related parties; volume of transactions with related parties noted in audit report; sales to related parties tested with reference to approvals under Sections 177 and 188 of the Act, agreements and pricing terms.
